en.headline: iAM Smart launches AI assistant to answer public service queries
en.dek: The Digital Policy Office said the new feature in the latest app version lets users ask questions and receive organised information drawn from official channels, with an enhanced version planned by year-end.
body: The Digital Policy Office announced today that iAM Smart has launched an AI assistant to answer queries about government public services.

The latest version of the mobile app, which includes the AI assistant, will be rolled out progressively to users via official app stores from today until late this month. Users can activate it by tapping the mascot Ah Chi on the home screen after installing the update.

A spokesperson said users only need to type a question and the assistant will search official sources in real time, then present the information clearly. For online service applications it can list conditions, steps and direct links, which can then be used with the form-filling feature.
The office said it will continue to refine the function and expects to release an enhanced version by the end of the year that provides more personalised services.

zh.headline: 智方便推出AI助手解答公共服務查詢
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室表示，最新版本應用程式加入AI助手，市民輸入問題即可從官方渠道取得整理後的資訊，年底將推出加強版。
body: 數字政策辦公室今日公布，智方便推出AI助手功能，解答有關政府公共服務的查詢。
備有AI助手的最新版本流動應用程式，將由即日起至本月下旬由官方應用程式商店逐步推送給用戶。用戶安裝更新後，在主頁點擊吉祥物阿智的頭像即可啟動。
發言人說，市民只需輸入問題，AI助手便會即時從官方渠道搜尋相關資訊，並整理成清晰內容。查詢網上服務申請時，還會列出條件、步驟及直接連結，配合填表通功能使用。
數字辦表示會持續優化功能，預計年底推出加強版，提供更多個人化服務。
